title: FlexLine Personal Lines of Credit — AutoPay and Due-Day Terms
content:
On FlexLine Personal Lines of Credit, AutoPay and the payment due day work as follows.

**AutoPay.** AutoPay can debit the minimum payment, the statement balance or a fixed amount (at least the minimum payment) from a verified linked account on each due date; while it is active the APR is lowered by the tier's AutoPay discount from the next billing cycle, and the discount ends from the next billing cycle after AutoPay stops.

**Due day.** The due day can be changed at most 1 time in any rolling 12 months, to a day from 1 to 28, on a line with no amount past due. The first due date on the new day is the first date on that day later than the current next due date. Whether an amount is past due is read from Larkspur's record of the line.

## Points of judgement

| Request | Allowed |
|---|---|
| New due day 28, no amount past due, no change in the rolling 12 months | Yes |
| New due day 30 | No — only days 1 to 28 |
| Any new due day while an amount is past due | No |
| A second change within the same rolling 12 months | No |

## First due date on the new day (hypothetical dates)

| Current next due date | New due day | First due date on the new day |
|---|---|---|
| 10 March | 20 | 20 March |
| 10 March | 5 | 5 April |

**When does an AutoPay rate reduction start?** From the billing cycle after AutoPay becomes active, and it ends from the billing cycle after AutoPay stops.

**Can a fixed AutoPay amount be below the minimum payment?** No; a fixed amount is at least the minimum payment.
